426:t_002:0.en:
$$葵$$
「All the $$スフィア・リアクター$$s volunteering to sortie together? Something serious must be going on.」

426:t_002:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「$n... Did you sense a $$サイデリアル$$ $$リアクター$$ approaching?」

426:t_002:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「To be honest, I don't really know.」

426:t_002:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I just have a bad feeling...」

426:t_002:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「We figured that at a time like this, we should see for ourselves, so we sortied.」

426:t_002:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's give it our best, $n. Your ex-girlfriend's at the base, right?」

426:t_002:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I wouldn't be that rude. Besides, I had my hands full holding back $$ロックオン$$, $$青山$$, $$デュオ$$, and $$クルツ$$.」

426:t_002:10.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I-I was... Well... It's an old habit. I was worried about $n...」

426:t_002:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Exactly! It's just our short-straw nature!」

426:t_002:13.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You kept insisting you weren't joining, but now you act like one of us whenever it suits you?」

426:t_002:14.en:
$$オズマ$$
「That's enough of the pointless chatter.」

426:t_002:15.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is coming!」

426:t_002:16.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, prepare to intercept! We can't let them take that base. We need it to investigate $$サイデリアル$$'s strategic aims!」

426:t_003:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「And $$アマルガム$$'s here too!」

426:t_003:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「So they've come all the way to this Earth on $$サイデリアル$$'s orders.」

426:t_003:4.en:
$$宗介$$
(If I keep fighting them, perhaps I can get information on $$アマルガム$$... and $$千鳥$$...)

426:t_003:5.en:
$$尸刻$$
「It's been a while, everyone in $c.」

426:t_003:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Polite talk won't help you, lady. That gloomy guy's behind you, right?」

426:t_003:8.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「If they're bringing out mass-produced versions of their commander's machine, the enemy must finally be getting serious!」

426:t_003:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「So we've lit a fire under their asses!」

426:t_003:10.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I won't deny it. $$サイデリアル$$ has judged you to possess that much power.」

426:t_003:11.en:
$$尸刻$$
「We in $$鬼宿$$ have also been ordered to deploy the $$尸冥爪$$. You will learn firsthand what that means.」

426:t_003:12.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's a roundabout way of putting it, but basically, you intend to crush us here.」

426:t_003:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「So the facilities at this base really are important to you.」

426:t_003:15.en:
$$桂$$
「You go quiet when something doesn't suit you. That's a classic move for a girl.」

426:t_003:16.en:
$$万丈$$
「Sorry, but we won't give in to threats. If you've deployed your ultimate weapon, we'll simply destroy it.」

426:t_003:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, stay alert! $$尸空#pilot$$ of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$ is probably waiting behind them!」

426:t_003:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Let's go, $n! When you're in doubt, move forward...! That's the iron rule!」

426:t_003:20.en:
$n
($$マキ#pilot$$, $$シンヤ#pilot$$, $$ミサコ#pilot$$... I'll protect you...!)

426:t_003:21.en:
$$レナード$$
「It looks like it's starting.」

426:t_003:22.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「We came here to inspect that system, only to find that the base has already fallen...」

426:t_003:23.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's fine. I felt inspiration just by getting close... That's enough.」

426:t_003:25.en:
$$レナード$$
「We've achieved our immediate goal. Let's watch $c for a while, then go home.」

426:t_003:26.en:
$$レナード$$
「We'll clash with them eventually... That isn't a hunch. I'm certain of it.」

426:t_005:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It seems there's been a slight delay.」

426:t_005:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I'll handle the rest. Fall back.」

426:t_006:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What kind of answer is that?! If you don't feel like fighting, go home!」

426:t_006:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you don't plan to leave.」

426:t_006:6.en:
$n
(Why do I feel like I can't breathe...?)

426:t_007:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Your woman got beaten, and you don't even bat an eye!」

426:t_007:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I may have told you before, but that isn't our relationship.」

426:t_007:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What kind of answer is that?! If you don't feel like fighting, go home!」

426:t_007:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you don't plan to leave.」

426:t_007:13.en:
$n
(Why do I feel like I can't breathe...?)

426:t_009:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Even after all that damage, we can't break through his nothingness?!」

426:t_011:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Are you bluffing? That isn't like you, $$尸空#pilot$$.」

426:t_011:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「A new $$リアクター$$ is coming.」
